scientific_integrity: The universal claim follows from the supplied proof, not finite experiments; earlier spectrum definitions and open-cell identification are attributed to Cardó.
scientific_limitations: Only two-element Boolean implication with no primitive constants or additional operations.
Exhaustive computational verification is bounded to four variables; constructive witnesses to eight.
Historical-priority risk: older equivalent results may be phrased outside equational probability terminology.
title: Sharp agreement spectra for the implication-only fragment of classical propositional logic
